rationale: Directional forces are sharply conflicted: the stock has strong fundamental support from an earnings beat that is keeping it up over 9% despite a severe broader market selloff (SPY -4.09%), yet intraday price action is weak as it trades below both session VWAP ($17.65) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($17.48) in the bottom quartile of its daily range. Furthermore, recent 1-minute volume has dried up to a few thousand shares per bar, offering no clear momentum trigger in either direction.
